approved_command_preview: Harden PR #427 lone-surrogate handling so package builders fail closed instead of moving UnicodeEncodeError downstream; add focused regression coverage; run focused self-tests and the full ten-command agent-runtime contract; commit only the six bounded builder/test files and push the guarded PR branch.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$branch = 'issue-426-human-first-openai-gpt-packages'
$expectedHead = '094c959ce4996e1c1a8d7602929535e6c84710e5'
$worktree = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'pr427-surrogate-failclosed'
$compressed = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'pr427-surrogate-failclosed.zlib'
$helper = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'pr427-surrogate-failclosed.py'
$payloadB64 = ''
function Invoke-Logged([string[]]$GitArgs) {
  Write-Host "git $($GitArgs -join ' ')"
  $output = & git @GitArgs
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  if ($output) { $output | Out-Host }
  if ($code -ne 0) { throw "git failed with exit $code`: git $($GitArgs -join ' ')" }
}
Invoke-Logged @('fetch','--no-tags','origin',"refs/heads/$branch`:refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
$remoteHead = (& git rev-parse "origin/$branch").Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $remoteHead -ne $expectedHead) { throw "Branch head guard failed: expected $expectedHead got $remoteHead" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $worktree) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $worktree -Recurse -Force }
Invoke-Logged @('worktree','add','--detach',$worktree,"origin/$branch")
Set-Location $worktree
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($compressed, [Convert]::FromBase64String($payloadB64))
python -c "import pathlib,zlib,sys; pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).write_bytes(zlib.decompress(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()))" $compressed $helper
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'helper decompression failed' }
python $helper
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'bounded edit helper failed' }
$py = @(
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py'
)
python -m py_compile @py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'py_compile failed' }
python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'DCOIR builder selftest failed' }
python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'USB builder selftest failed' }
python project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'combined deployment release selftest failed' }
$commands = @(
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/validate_shared_agent_source_contract.py'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/validate_shared_agent_source_contract_selftest.py'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/materialize_agent_behavior_adapters.py','--check'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/materialize_agent_behavior_adapters_selftest.py'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/project_agent_knowledge.py','--check'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/project_agent_knowledge_selftest.py'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py','--check'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py','--check'),
 @('project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py')
)
foreach ($entry in $commands) {
  python @entry
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Governed agent-runtime command failed: python $($entry -join ' ')" }
}
Invoke-Logged @('diff','--check')
$allowed = @(
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_dcoir_analyst.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_usb_reporting.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tools/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_dcoir_analyst_selftest.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_usb_reporting_selftest.py',
 'project_sources/agent_runtime/tests/build_openai_gpt_deployment_release_selftest.py'
)
$changed = @(& git status --porcelain | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(3) })
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git status failed' }
$unexpected = @($changed | Where-Object { $_ -notin $allowed })
if ($unexpected.Count -gt 0) { throw "Unexpected changed paths: $($unexpected -join ', ')" }
if ($changed.Count -ne $allowed.Count) { throw "Expected $($allowed.Count) changed paths, got $($changed.Count): $($changed -join ', ')" }
Invoke-Logged @('fetch','--no-tags','origin',"refs/heads/$branch`:refs/remotes/origin/$branch")
$remoteHead2 = (& git rev-parse "origin/$branch").Trim()
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $remoteHead2 -ne $expectedHead) { throw "Pre-push branch head guard failed: expected $expectedHead got $remoteHead2" }
Invoke-Logged @('config','user.name','github-actions[bot]')
Invoke-Logged @('config','user.email','41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com')
Invoke-Logged (@('add','--') + $allowed)
Invoke-Logged @('commit','-m','Fail closed on lone UTF-16 surrogates')
Invoke-Logged @('push','origin',"HEAD:refs/heads/$branch")
Write-Host 'Final branch head:'
Invoke-Logged @('rev-parse','HEAD')
Write-Host 'Final branch status:'
Invoke-Logged @('status','--short')
